purpose: Private local evaluation of Polish receipt OCR and vision extraction. This is not a training dataset.

downloaded.quality: High-resolution handheld photo; slight perspective and thermal-paper noise; fully useful as a realistic baseline.
downloaded.privacy: No customer name, phone number or loyalty-card identifier is visible. Store address and fiscal identifiers are business data.
downloaded.notes: Older than the preferred 2023-2026 window, retained because it is the only verified real Polish chain receipt found with an explicit reusable license.

downloaded.license: Official press attachment offered with a download action; no open-content license stated. Keep for private local QA and do not redistribute independently.
downloaded.attribution: Biuro Prasowe Biedronka / Jeronimo Martins Polska S.A.
downloaded.quality: Clean, straight electronic visualization; small but readable; two item lines.
downloaded.privacy: Payment-card number is masked in the official image; a few trailing digits remain visible. No customer name is shown.
downloaded.notes: Useful for validating e-receipt parsing, but easier than a phone photo.

downloaded.license: Derived crop from page 23 of Lidl's public promotional-lottery rules; no open-content license stated. Keep for private local QA and do not redistribute independently.
downloaded.quality: Small, clean receipt visualization with readable products, VAT, total, payment and barcode; colored annotations mark date, receipt number and total.
downloaded.privacy: The regulation calls this an example visualization; identifiers are sample data rather than a customer's personal data.
downloaded.notes: Not a real shopper photo. Do not count it as evidence of performance on camera distortion or damaged thermal paper.

remoteOnly.quality: Image search preview exposes a readable receipt with five product lines and discounts.
remoteOnly.reasonNotDownloaded: Fakt marks the media as copyrighted and its site explicitly reserves automated TDM/AI use. Link only; request permission or use the owner's own receipt instead.
remoteOnly.notes: Store identity is supported by the receipt header and article context.

remoteOnly.quality: Long Auchan receipt photographed beside a Biedronka receipt; useful for long-document and small-text stress testing.
remoteOnly.reasonNotDownloaded: User-generated content with no reusable license. The post is public, but public visibility is not permission to copy it into a repository.
remoteOnly.notes: The author explicitly identifies the receipt as Auchan and discussion references the visible 571.68 PLN total.

remoteOnly.quality: Article gallery reportedly includes a large discounted basket and its receipt.
remoteOnly.reasonNotDownloaded: Fakt prohibits automated TDM/AI use and credits third-party Instagram material.
remoteOnly.notes: Alternative link if permission is obtained; do not use it automatically.

remoteOnly.quality: Article includes close photos of a 55 cm receipt/printout set from Carrefour at ul. Dolna in Warsaw; only a few purchased items.
remoteOnly.reasonNotDownloaded: Images are credited © o2.pl and no reusable license is stated.
remoteOnly.notes: Store is explicitly confirmed by the article and Carrefour's quoted response.

remoteOnly.quality: Low-resolution side-by-side photo; two products on the Biedronka receipt and one on the Lidl receipt.
remoteOnly.reasonNotDownloaded: No reuse license is stated; the accessible preview is only 250x181 and is too small for a fair OCR benchmark.
remoteOnly.notes: Useful as a human reference for receipt-length differences, not as a model benchmark.

remoteOnly.quality: Clean synthetic receipt visualization embedded in contest rules; two product lines.
remoteOnly.reasonNotDownloaded: No open license is stated and the content is synthetic, so it adds little beyond the licensed/official samples already stored.
remoteOnly.notes: No verifiable modern real E.Leclerc receipt photo with reusable rights was found.

coverageGaps: No reusable modern real receipt photo was found for Żabka, Auchan, Carrefour or E.Leclerc.
The downloaded 2024 Biedronka e-receipt and 2025 Lidl receipt are clean visualizations, not difficult camera photos.
For a defensible benchmark, collect owner-consented receipts from the target stores and keep the original image plus a manually verified expected JSON file.
